_comment: Optional per-film enrichment, keyed by film id (see films.json). Any field listed here overrides the auto-generated value. To add new fields, edit this file and rerun build (no code change needed).

dostoyevsky-pickpocket.synopsis_en: Bresson's elliptical adaptation of Crime and Punishment as a study of a young Parisian thief — gestures of hands, the architecture of guilt.
dostoyevsky-pickpocket.synopsis_zh: 布列松将《罪与罚》缩进巴黎街头一位扒手的双手与目光之间。手部动作的精确编排，构成了罪与悔的几何。

dostoyevsky-the-brothers-karamazov.synopsis_en: A monumental Soviet adaptation of Dostoyevsky's final novel — the four sons, the father, the lacerating question of who is responsible for what.
dostoyevsky-the-brothers-karamazov.synopsis_zh: 苏联电影对陀思妥耶夫斯基绝笔之作的宏大改编：四个儿子、一个父亲，以及那个反复撕咬的问题——谁该为这一切负责。

dostoyevsky-crime-and-punishment.synopsis_en: Kulidzhanov's two-part Crime and Punishment, faithful to the novel's interior weather — Raskolnikov in close-up, Petersburg in fog.
dostoyevsky-crime-and-punishment.synopsis_zh: 库利贾诺夫两部曲式的《罪与罚》，忠实地呈现了小说的内在天气：拉斯科尔尼科夫的特写，与雾中的彼得堡。

dostoyevsky-the-double.synopsis_en: Ayoade's dread-comic riff on Dostoyevsky's novella — a meek office worker meets the man who is exactly him, only confident.
dostoyevsky-the-double.synopsis_zh: 阿尤阿德将陀思妥耶夫斯基的中篇拍成了焦虑喜剧：怯懦的办公室职员遇见了与自己一模一样、只是更加自信的他。

dostoyevsky-enemy.synopsis_en: Villeneuve's Toronto-set doppelgänger thriller, drawing on Saramago and Dostoyevsky alike — a sallow gold-lit unease that does not let go.
dostoyevsky-enemy.synopsis_zh: 维伦纽瓦在多伦多拍摄的双生人惊悚片，兼取材自萨拉马戈与陀思妥耶夫斯基。蜡黄金色的不安，一旦缠上便不肯松开。

tribute-wilder-monroe-double-indemnity.synopsis_en: An insurance salesman and a discontented wife conspire toward a perfect murder. The film noir blueprint.
tribute-wilder-monroe-double-indemnity.synopsis_zh: 一名保险推销员与一位不满的妻子合谋一桩完美谋杀。黑色电影自此有了蓝图。

tribute-wilder-monroe-the-lost-weekend.synopsis_en: Four days inside the bender of a Manhattan writer who cannot finish anything except a drink.
tribute-wilder-monroe-the-lost-weekend.synopsis_zh: 曼哈顿一位写作者四天的酗酒长夜——他什么都写不完，只能喝光每一杯。

tribute-wilder-monroe-a-foreign-affair.synopsis_en: Postwar Berlin, half-rubble: an Iowa congresswoman, an Army captain, and a cabaret singer with a past.
tribute-wilder-monroe-a-foreign-affair.synopsis_zh: 战后半成废墟的柏林：一位爱荷华女议员、一名陆军上尉，与一位带着过去的歌厅歌手。

tribute-wilder-monroe-ace-in-the-hole.synopsis_en: A washed-up reporter milks a New Mexico cave-in for every column inch it's worth. Wilder at his most acid.
tribute-wilder-monroe-ace-in-the-hole.synopsis_zh: 一名失意记者把新墨西哥洞窟塌方榨成头条专栏的每一寸版面。怀尔德最酸的一次出手。

tribute-wilder-monroe-sabrina.synopsis_en: A chauffeur's daughter returns from Paris transformed. Two brothers — one ascetic, one rakish — both notice.
tribute-wilder-monroe-sabrina.synopsis_zh: 司机的女儿从巴黎归来，已是另一个人。两兄弟——一位禁欲、一位风流——都察觉到了。

tribute-wilder-monroe-some-like-it-hot.synopsis_en: Two Chicago musicians witness a massacre and flee in drag with an all-girl orchestra to Florida. Nobody's perfect.
tribute-wilder-monroe-some-like-it-hot.synopsis_zh: 两名芝加哥乐手目击屠杀，乔装成女子，混入一支女子乐团逃往佛罗里达。没人完美。

tribute-wilder-monroe-the-apartment.synopsis_en: An ambitious clerk lends out his apartment to executives, then begins to lose what he thought he wanted.
tribute-wilder-monroe-the-apartment.synopsis_zh: 一名向上爬的小职员把公寓借给上司幽会，渐渐失去了他以为想要的一切。

tribute-wilder-monroe-the-misfits.synopsis_en: Nevada divorcée meets three drifting cowboys. Monroe's last finished film, written by Arthur Miller.
tribute-wilder-monroe-the-misfits.synopsis_zh: 内华达的离婚女子遇见三名漂泊的牛仔。梦露最后完成的电影，剧本出自阿瑟·米勒之手。

tribute-ken-loach-kes.synopsis_en: A Yorkshire schoolboy from a hard family finds a kestrel chick and, briefly, something to be proud of.
tribute-ken-loach-kes.synopsis_zh: 约克郡一户艰难家庭的少年，发现了一只茶隼幼鸟，从此短暂地有了可以骄傲的东西。

tribute-ken-loach-family-life.synopsis_en: A young woman's breakdown, and the institutions — family, psychiatry, the state — that converge on her.
tribute-ken-loach-family-life.synopsis_zh: 一位年轻女子的崩溃，以及向她聚拢的所有机制：家庭、精神病学、国家。

tribute-ken-loach-ladybird-ladybird.synopsis_en: A working-class mother in Liverpool fights social services for her own children. Based on a true story.
tribute-ken-loach-ladybird-ladybird.synopsis_zh: 利物浦一位工人阶级母亲，与社会福利机构争夺自己的孩子。改编自真人真事。

tribute-ken-loach-i-daniel-blake.synopsis_en: A Newcastle carpenter, after a heart attack, is told by an algorithm that he is fit to work. Palme d'Or, 2016.
tribute-ken-loach-i-daniel-blake.synopsis_zh: 纽卡斯尔一位木匠心脏病发后，被一套算法判定为'适合工作'。2016 年金棕榈。

tribute-ken-loach-sorry-we-missed-you.synopsis_en: A gig-economy delivery driver and his care-worker wife try to hold a family together one shift at a time.
tribute-ken-loach-sorry-we-missed-you.synopsis_zh: 一名零工经济快递员，与照护工作的妻子，一班一班地试图把家庭维系在一起。

tribute-ken-loach-the-old-oak.synopsis_en: In a former Durham mining village, a pub landlord and a young Syrian photographer try to make a community.
tribute-ken-loach-the-old-oak.synopsis_zh: 在德罕一座旧矿村，酒馆老板与一位年轻的叙利亚摄影师，尝试重新拼出一个社区。

tribute-ken-loach-versus-the-life-and-fi.synopsis_en: A documentary portrait of Ken Loach — fifty years of films, principles, and arguments.
tribute-ken-loach-versus-the-life-and-fi.synopsis_zh: 一部肯·洛奇的纪录肖像：五十年的电影、原则与争论。

sci-fi-week-ai-artificial-intelligence.synopsis_en: A small android boy is left in a future where humanity has thinned to coastal cities. He looks for his mother.
sci-fi-week-ai-artificial-intelligence.synopsis_zh: 未来人类退缩至沿海少数城市，一个小小的机械男孩被遗下。他出门去找他的母亲。

sci-fi-week-fantastic-planet.synopsis_en: A 1973 animated parable: blue giants keep miniature humans as pets, until the small ones learn to read.
sci-fi-week-fantastic-planet.synopsis_zh: 1973 年的动画寓言：蓝色巨人将人类当作宠物豢养，直到这些'小东西'学会了阅读。

sci-fi-week-the-masters-of-time.synopsis_en: On the desert planet Perdide, a stranded boy waits to be rescued by a voice across space. Designed by Mœbius.
sci-fi-week-the-masters-of-time.synopsis_zh: 沙漠星球佩尔迪德上，一个孤独的男孩等待来自太空的声音救援。墨比斯设计美术。

sci-fi-week-gandahar.synopsis_en: An idyllic kingdom is invaded by metal men, sent — perhaps — by the kingdom's own future.
sci-fi-week-gandahar.synopsis_zh: 一座田园王国遭遇金属人入侵，而那些机器或许来自王国自身的未来。

new-horizons-imax-tommy.synopsis_en: Ken Russell's hallucinatory rock opera based on The Who's album. Deaf, dumb, blind kid sure plays a mean pinball.
new-horizons-imax-tommy.synopsis_zh: 肯·罗素根据 The Who 同名专辑拍摄的迷幻摇滚歌剧。又聋又哑又盲，却把弹珠台打得震天响。

new-horizons-imax-rolling-stones-at-the-.synopsis_en: The Rolling Stones' Urban Jungle tour, shot in IMAX. The first concert film made for the format.
new-horizons-imax-rolling-stones-at-the-.synopsis_zh: 滚石乐队 Urban Jungle 巡演的 IMAX 现场。该格式上第一部演唱会电影。

new-horizons-imax-cave-of-forgotten-drea.synopsis_en: Herzog enters the Chauvet caves with 3D cameras. Thirty-two thousand years of charcoal horses.
new-horizons-imax-cave-of-forgotten-drea.synopsis_zh: 赫尔佐格带 3D 摄影机走进肖维洞穴。三万两千年前的炭笔群马。

new-horizons-imax-dune-part-one.synopsis_en: House Atreides arrives on Arrakis. Villeneuve's first half of Herbert's epic — sandstorms, ornithopters, prophecy.
new-horizons-imax-dune-part-one.synopsis_zh: 厄崔迪家族抵达阿拉基斯。维伦纽瓦版赫伯特史诗的上半部——沙暴、扑翼机、预言。

new-horizons-imax-dune-part-two.synopsis_en: Paul among the Fremen. Vengeance, holy war, the choice that becomes a religion.
new-horizons-imax-dune-part-two.synopsis_zh: 保罗加入弗雷曼人。复仇、圣战，以及一个选择如何成为一种信仰。

new-horizons-imax-epic-elvis-presley-in-.synopsis_en: A new IMAX concert document built from restored archival footage of Elvis Presley in performance.
new-horizons-imax-epic-elvis-presley-in-.synopsis_zh: 由修复档案影像构成的 IMAX 演唱会纪录：埃尔维斯·普雷斯利的现场。

new-horizons-imax-stormbound.synopsis_en: A 2025 IMAX feature; full credits to be confirmed at festival.
new-horizons-imax-stormbound.synopsis_zh: 2025 年 IMAX 长片，详细资料待电影节公布。

new-horizons-imax-weapons.synopsis_en: A small town. Seventeen children walk out of their houses at exactly 2:17 a.m. None of them comes back.
new-horizons-imax-weapons.synopsis_zh: 一座小镇。十七个孩子在凌晨 2 点 17 分整一齐离家出走，无一归来。

new-horizons-dolby-the-transformers-the-.synopsis_en: The 1986 animated feature in Dolby Vision — Autobots, Decepticons, Unicron the planet-eater.
new-horizons-dolby-the-transformers-the-.synopsis_zh: 1986 年动画长片的杜比视界版本——汽车人、霸天虎，与吞噬星球的宇宙大帝。

new-horizons-dolby-novocaine.synopsis_en: A man who feels no pain is the wrong person to rob. An action comedy in Dolby Vision HDR.
new-horizons-dolby-novocaine.synopsis_zh: 对一个感觉不到痛的人下手抢劫，是糟糕的选择。杜比视界 HDR 的动作喜剧。

auteurs-new-father-mother-sister-brother.synopsis_en: Jarmusch's family triptych — three pairs of adult siblings visiting their parents, on three continents.
auteurs-new-father-mother-sister-brother.synopsis_zh: 贾木许的家庭三联画：三对成年手足，分别在三大洲探访父母。

auteurs-new-bugonia.synopsis_en: Two conspiracy theorists kidnap a pharmaceutical CEO they believe to be a saboteur from outer space.
auteurs-new-bugonia.synopsis_zh: 两个阴谋论者绑架了一名药企首席执行官，因为他们坚信她是来自外太空的破坏者。

auteurs-new-magellan.synopsis_en: Lav Diaz follows Ferdinand Magellan from Lisbon to the beach at Mactan. History at the pace of memory.
auteurs-new-magellan.synopsis_zh: 拉夫·达兹跟随麦哲伦的脚步，从里斯本一路至麦克坦海滩。以记忆的步速重走历史。

auteurs-new-mirrors-no-3.synopsis_en: A young woman survives a car crash and is taken in by a stranger's family. Petzold's third 'mirror' story.
auteurs-new-mirrors-no-3.synopsis_zh: 一位年轻女子在车祸中幸存，被一户陌生人家接纳。佩措尔德的第三则'镜面'故事。

film-history-intolerance.synopsis_en: Four stories of intolerance braided together across millennia — Babylon, Judea, Renaissance France, modern America.
film-history-intolerance.synopsis_zh: 四段跨越千年的'不宽容'故事彼此交织——巴比伦、犹太、文艺复兴时期的法国，与现代美国。

film-history-mother.synopsis_en: Pudovkin's 1926 adaptation of Gorky's novel — a woman in revolutionary Russia learns whose side she is on.
film-history-mother.synopsis_zh: 普多夫金 1926 年改编自高尔基的同名小说：革命中的俄罗斯，一位母亲学到了她该站在哪一边。

film-history-its-a-wonderful-life.synopsis_en: On Christmas Eve, a small-town banker sees what his town would have been without him.
film-history-its-a-wonderful-life.synopsis_zh: 圣诞夜，小镇银行家看到了一个没有他的世界会是何模样。

film-history-the-searchers.synopsis_en: Ford's Monument Valley elegy — Ethan Edwards walks for years looking for his niece, and for whatever's still in him.
film-history-the-searchers.synopsis_zh: 福特拍下的纪念碑谷挽歌：伊森·爱德华兹走了多年，去找他的侄女，也去找他体内还剩下什么。

film-history-come-drink-with-me.synopsis_en: King Hu's wuxia milestone — Golden Swallow, the inn, the bandits, the choreography that became a vocabulary.
film-history-come-drink-with-me.synopsis_zh: 胡金铨的武侠里程碑——金燕子、客栈、群匪，与日后成为类型语汇的动作编排。

film-history-the-cassandra-crossing.synopsis_en: A transcontinental train carries a contagion toward a condemned bridge. Sophia Loren, Richard Harris.
film-history-the-cassandra-crossing.synopsis_zh: 一列跨洲列车载着一种瘟疫，驶向一座废弃的桥。索菲娅·罗兰、理查德·哈里斯主演。

film-history-the-english-patient.synopsis_en: A burned man in a Tuscan villa remembers North Africa, a wife, and a desert that owes him nothing.
film-history-the-english-patient.synopsis_zh: 托斯卡纳别墅中的烧伤者，回忆起北非、一位妻子，以及一片对他毫无亏欠的沙漠。

tribute-memorial-the-bucket-list.synopsis_en: Two terminally ill men leave the hospital with a list. Jack Nicholson, Morgan Freeman.
tribute-memorial-the-bucket-list.synopsis_zh: 两位末期病人带着一份清单离开医院。杰克·尼科尔森、摩根·弗里曼主演。

tribute-memorial-flipped.synopsis_en: Two narrators, one street. He thinks she's strange. She knows he's the boy from the day she moved in.
tribute-memorial-flipped.synopsis_zh: 两位旁白，一条街道。他觉得她奇怪；她从搬进来那天就认定，是他。

tribute-memorial-stand-by-me.synopsis_en: Four boys walk along the train tracks to find a body. A coming-of-age dispatch.
tribute-memorial-stand-by-me.synopsis_zh: 四个男孩沿着铁路寻找一具尸体。一篇成长报告。

tribute-memorial-when-harry-met-sally.synopsis_en: Twelve years of meeting, missing, becoming friends, and the famous deli scene in between.
tribute-memorial-when-harry-met-sally.synopsis_zh: 十二年的相遇与擦身、成为朋友——以及那场著名的熟食店戏。

tribute-memorial-misery.synopsis_en: A writer's number-one fan saves him from a snowstorm and into something worse.
tribute-memorial-misery.synopsis_zh: 一位作家'第一粉丝'将他从暴风雪中救起，却把他带向更糟的处境。

tribute-memorial-a-few-good-men.synopsis_en: Two Marines in Guantanamo, a court martial, and a colonel asked whether he can handle the truth.
tribute-memorial-a-few-good-men.synopsis_zh: 关塔那摩两名海军陆战队员、一场军事法庭，与一位被问及'能否承受真相'的上校。

tribute-memorial-annie-hall.synopsis_en: Alvy Singer, neurotic New York comedian, looks back on a relationship that didn't last but mattered.
tribute-memorial-annie-hall.synopsis_zh: 纽约神经质喜剧演员阿尔维·辛格回望一段未能持续、却至关重要的关系。

tribute-memorial-contempt.synopsis_en: A screenwriter in Capri loses his wife between scenes. Bardot, Piccoli, Fritz Lang as himself.
tribute-memorial-contempt.synopsis_zh: 卡普里岛上，一位编剧在两场戏之间失去了妻子。芭铎、皮科利，弗里茨·朗本色出演。

tribute-memorial-sorrows-and-joys-of-a-m.synopsis_en: Shanghai, 1949. A widowed teacher and the women, students, and obligations around him.
tribute-memorial-sorrows-and-joys-of-a-m.synopsis_zh: 1949 年的上海。丧偶教师与他身边的女性、学生、责任。

tribute-memorial-phony-phoenixes.synopsis_en: A 1947 Shanghai screwball: two impostors meet at a marriage broker's, each convinced the other is rich.
tribute-memorial-phony-phoenixes.synopsis_zh: 1947 年的上海闹剧：两个冒名顶替者在媒人处相遇，各自以为对方是富翁。

tribute-memorial-murder-in-405.synopsis_en: An early-Reform-era Chinese mystery: a hospital ward, a corpse, an investigator from Shanghai.
tribute-memorial-murder-in-405.synopsis_zh: 改革开放初年的中国推理：医院 405 病房、一具尸体，与来自上海的调查者。

tribute-memorial-family-nest.synopsis_en: Tarr's first feature: a young couple in a tiny Budapest flat shared with the husband's parents.
tribute-memorial-family-nest.synopsis_zh: 塔尔的处女作：一对年轻夫妇，住在与丈夫父母合用的狭小布达佩斯公寓。

tribute-memorial-the-outsider.synopsis_en: A drifting musician moves between gigs and lovers and jobs that won't keep.
tribute-memorial-the-outsider.synopsis_zh: 一位漂泊的乐手在演出、情人与留不住的工作之间游走。

tribute-memorial-the-prefab-people.synopsis_en: A marriage filmed in fifteen minutes of long takes and a decade of grievance.
tribute-memorial-the-prefab-people.synopsis_zh: 一段婚姻，由十几分钟的长镜头与十年积怨拍成。

tribute-memorial-almanac-of-fall.synopsis_en: Five people circle each other in a decaying apartment, in red and green light. Tarr's chromatic chamber drama.
tribute-memorial-almanac-of-fall.synopsis_zh: 五人在一处衰败公寓内彼此盘旋，红与绿的灯光下。塔尔的色彩室内剧。

tribute-memorial-damnation.synopsis_en: A man in a rain-soaked mining town informs on the husband of the woman he loves. Tarr finds his style.
tribute-memorial-damnation.synopsis_zh: 雨水浸透的矿镇里，一个男人向当局告发他所爱女人的丈夫。塔尔自此找到自己的风格。

tribute-memorial-satans-tango.synopsis_en: Seven hours, twelve chapters, one collapsed collective farm. A dance, again and again, in the mud.
tribute-memorial-satans-tango.synopsis_zh: 七小时、十二章节、一座崩溃的集体农庄。在泥泞中反复跳起的同一支舞。

tribute-memorial-werckmeister-harmonies.synopsis_en: A whale arrives in a Hungarian town in a wooden trailer. So does a riot. Cosmic, bleak, exact.
tribute-memorial-werckmeister-harmonies.synopsis_zh: 一头鲸鱼装在木拖车里进了匈牙利小镇。一场骚乱随之到来。宇宙性的、阴郁的、精确的。

tribute-memorial-the-man-from-london.synopsis_en: A harbor signalman witnesses a murder, and a suitcase changes hands in the dark.
tribute-memorial-the-man-from-london.synopsis_zh: 港口信号员目睹了一桩谋杀，黑暗中一只手提箱易主。

tribute-memorial-the-turin-horse.synopsis_en: Six days at the end of the world. Wind, potatoes, an old man, his daughter, and a horse that will not eat.
tribute-memorial-the-turin-horse.synopsis_zh: 世界末日的六天。风、土豆、一位老人、他的女儿，以及一匹不肯进食的马。

siff-rhapsody-amadeus.synopsis_en: Salieri tells the story of his colleague Mozart, in confession, from an asylum.
siff-rhapsody-amadeus.synopsis_zh: 萨列里在疯人院里向神父告解，讲述他的同行莫扎特的故事。

siff-rhapsody-finding-vivian-maier.director_zh: 约翰·马卢夫、查理·西斯凯尔
siff-rhapsody-finding-vivian-maier.synopsis_en: A box of negatives at a Chicago auction turns out to be one of the great unseen photographic archives.
siff-rhapsody-finding-vivian-maier.synopsis_zh: 芝加哥一场拍卖中买下的一箱底片，最终被证实是有史以来最重要的隐匿摄影档案之一。

siff-rhapsody-in-i-in-motion.synopsis_en: A 2025 dance-on-film hybrid documenting the stage work In-I.
siff-rhapsody-in-i-in-motion.synopsis_zh: 2025 年的舞蹈电影混合作品，记录舞台剧《In-I》的演出。

siff-rhapsody-the-yellow-tie.synopsis_en: A 2025 musical portrait; details to be confirmed at festival.
siff-rhapsody-the-yellow-tie.synopsis_zh: 2025 年的一部音乐人物片，详情待电影节公布。

siff-rhapsody-the-great-arch.synopsis_en: The story of La Grande Arche de la Défense and the Danish architect who never quite saw it finished.
siff-rhapsody-the-great-arch.synopsis_zh: 拉德芳斯新凯旋门的故事——那位最终未能亲见落成的丹麦建筑师。

siff-rhapsody-the-moment.synopsis_en: A 2026 music documentary; details to be confirmed at festival.
siff-rhapsody-the-moment.synopsis_zh: 2026 年的音乐纪录片，详情待电影节公布。

official-selection-nuremberg.synopsis_en: The 1945 Nuremberg trials told through the American psychiatrist who interviewed Hermann Göring.
official-selection-nuremberg.synopsis_zh: 通过那位审问赫尔曼·戈林的美国精神病医师之眼，重述 1945 年的纽伦堡审判。

official-selection-case-137.synopsis_en: A French police-misconduct investigator opens dossier No. 137. Procedural, exact, very cold.
official-selection-case-137.synopsis_zh: 法国警察渎职调查员打开第 137 号档案。程序、精确、极冷。

official-selection-sirat.synopsis_en: A father searches for his daughter at a desert rave. The world keeps unmaking itself.
official-selection-sirat.synopsis_zh: 一位父亲在沙漠锐舞派对中寻找自己的女儿。世界一直在自我解体。

belt-and-road-a-loose-end.synopsis_en: A 2025 thriller from along the Belt and Road; full credits to be confirmed.
belt-and-road-a-loose-end.synopsis_zh: 2025 年来自一带一路沿线国家的惊悚片，全部主创信息待公布。

siff-animation-a-magnificent-life.synopsis_en: Sylvain Chomet animates the life of Marcel Pagnol, novelist and filmmaker of Provence.
siff-animation-a-magnificent-life.synopsis_zh: 西尔万·肖梅以动画讲述普罗旺斯的小说家与电影人马塞尔·帕尼奥尔的一生。

siff-animation-the-land-of-sometimes.synopsis_en: A 2026 family animated feature about a kingdom where almost anything is possible — sometimes.
siff-animation-the-land-of-sometimes.synopsis_zh: 2026 年的家庭动画长片，讲述一座几乎一切皆可能——但只是有时候——的王国。
